svg.aria-label: Flow: a denial arrives as an 835 remittance with reason codes; it is checked against the payer criteria in force on the date of service; a response is drafted from the chart with every statement citing a chart entry; the LITMUS gate checks every statement is warranted; if yes, the physician reviews and signs; if no, the draft is blocked and the physician decides.
